evidence.summary: A logistics-company workflow was described as receiving about 50 supplier-invoice PDFs weekly and manually typing price, quantity and SKU line items into Excel for roughly four hours each Friday; the poster said existing tools felt expensive or complex.
A freight-industry discussion asks about repeated read-and-retype work from unstructured shipping documents and emails into spreadsheets or CRMs.
Docparser publicly offers document parsing and CSV/JSON/Excel export, with a Starter monthly tier shown at $39/month.
Nanonets publicly offers invoice/data extraction with usage-based workflow pricing and a paid Starter level after introductory credits.

constraints: Do not persist uploaded PDF bytes in the MVP application.
Do not target bank statements in Run #001.
Do not publish a monthly document quota until usage metering is implemented.
Public pricing must match the verified Lemon Squeezy Price object.
Website claims must remain limited to functionality that exists in the shipped build.
